# vite-template

> Personal SPA starter: Vite, React, TanStack Router, Tailwind v4, shadcn Base UI.

## For product forks

- Replace this file when the site has real public content worth citing.
- List only pages that should appear in training or citation corpora.
- Omit auth, dashboard, and internal tools.
- Client-rendered SPAs still need prerender before training crawlers that skip JavaScript can see body copy; for this router that means TanStack Start's prerendering (the usual SSG plugins do not support file-based TanStack Router).

## Pages

- [Home](/): template lander and product entry once forked
